description: This file contains unit tests for font resolving mechanisms in the PDFsharp library, specifically testing different font resolvers, font fallback, and handling of various font face names.

classes.name: FontResolverTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing font resolver functionality and fallback behavior within the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: ArialShouldSucceed
methods.description: Asserts that the font resolution for Arial face name succeeds with the expected face name.

methods.name: ArialShouldFail
methods.description: Asserts that the font resolution for Arial face name fails as expected.

methods.name: ArialShouldBeReplacedBy
methods.description: Asserts that the font face name for Arial is replaced by a specified name.

methods.name: DummyShouldFail
methods.description: Asserts that resolving a dummy font face name fails.

methods.name: DummyShouldBeReplacedBy
methods.description: Verifies that a dummy font name is replaced by a specified face name.

methods.name: SegoeUIShouldSucceed
methods.description: Asserts successful resolution of 'Segoe UI' font.

methods.name: SegoeUIShouldFail
methods.description: Asserts failure to resolve 'Segoe UI' font.

methods.name: SegoeUIShouldBeReplacedBy
methods.description: Verifies 'Segoe UI' font is replaced by a specified face name.

methods.name: XFilesShouldBeReplacedBy
methods.description: Verifies 'X-Files' font is replaced by a specified face name.

methods.name: EnsureSuccess
methods.description: Helper to verify that a font face name resolves to the expected face name.

methods.name: EnsureFail
methods.description: Helper to verify that font resolution fails for a given face name.
